title: Hashrate is at record highs while pay is down 18%
description:
Hashrate is at record highs while pay is down 18%

In this short: what the mining data actually shows this week, and what it means for a miner.

• Bitcoin hashrate rebounded to about 1.065 ZH/s (1,065 EH/s) after dropping to roughly 912 EH/s on 14 November (Cointribune, 2026-11-22)
• Hashprice fell to 26.16 USD per PH/s per day on 21 November 2026 (Hashrate Index via Cointribune, 2026-11-22)
• Hashprice was 31.89 USD per PH/s per day on 9 November 2026 (30-day average 35.73) (Hashrate Index via Cryptoticker, 2026-11-12)
• Next difficulty adjustment expected around 27 November 2026 with an estimated increase of about 8.99% (Cointribune, 2026-11-22)
• The previous difficulty adjustment (13 November 2026) was a decrease of about 9.13% (Cointribune, 2026-11-22)
